run_metadata.coverage_summary: All source tiers were attempted (Tier 1 Commonwealth + all states/territories; Tier 2 councils/GBEs/universities/health; Tier 3 private-sector e-sourcing hubs and major-buyer portals; plus a dedicated source-discovery sweep). Connectivity was re-tested at the start of the run: WebFetch returned EGRESS_BLOCKED and a direct curl returned '403 CONNECT tunnel failed' for external hosts including the Tier 1 control fetch to www.tenders.gov.au. The agent-proxy status endpoint reports enabled=true, selective=false, bundleCoversEveryHost=true, recentRelayFailures empty, but every external CONNECT is rejected (only infrastructure hosts in noProxy - Anthropic API, package registries - are reachable). This is the SAME session-wide deny-by-default egress block seen on the 2026-09-30, 2026-10-01, 2026-10-02, 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-04 runs - now six consecutive days. Per the proxy README this is an organisation policy denial that must be reported, not routed around. WebSearch still works (it routes through the Anthropic API, not the egress proxy) and was used for a source-discovery sweep across Tier 1-3 and to surface recent opportunities. Because the spec's fidelity rule requires every tender detail to be taken from the actual notice or its documents, and no notice page could be opened or verified, NO opportunity could be confirmed - so this run records ZERO tenders rather than repeating unverified aggregator/search snippets. The source-discovery sweep surfaced five buyer-originated procurement sources not present in any prior run (Airservices Australia supplier/procurement; Pilbara Ports Authority tenders; Flinders Ports procurement; Australian Defence Industry Portal / AusDIP via BenchOn; Moonee Valley City Council tenders); all are recorded in discovered_sources at medium/low confidence with a clear note that they were surfaced via WebSearch and could NOT be fetch-verified this run due to the egress block. No tenders, deliverables, dates, contacts, or corporate opportunities were invented.
gaps: Session-wide organisation egress block (6th consecutive day): WebFetch returns EGRESS_BLOCKED and direct curl returns '403 CONNECT tunnel failed' for external hosts (control fetch to www.tenders.gov.au rejected). No external website could be opened or verified.

Tier 1 (AusTender, NSW eTendering/buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders): attempted but UNREACHABLE - every notice/detail page blocked by egress policy; zero tenders could be verified.
Tier 2 (councils via VendorPanel, GBEs/government-owned corporations, universities/TAFEs, public health): attempted via WebSearch only; no detail page could be fetched to verify an opportunity.

Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, Coupa/Jaggaer/GEP/Ivalua, RangeMe, and major-buyer portals BHP/Rio Tinto/Woodside/Woolworths/Coles etc.): attempted via WebSearch only; all portals remain unreachable for fetch. No corporate opportunity could be verified; none invented. Login/registration-gated and invitation-only corporate RFx remain out of scope per spec.

Opportunities surfaced by WebSearch but NOT recorded as tenders (could not be fetch-verified, so treated as discovery signal only, not source-of-truth): Airservices Australia RFI for an Enterprise AI Broker Platform (conversational AI / RAG / workflow automation, IRAP-compliant) - advertised via AusTender; Airservices Australia RFI for an interim control tower solution at Ballina Byron Gateway Airport NSW (~5 years ATC services); Moonee Valley City Council (VIC) Concrete Maintenance Services tender reportedly closing ~2 Oct 2026; SSROC (Southern Sydney Regional Organisation of Councils) tender with close extended to 2:00pm AEDT Fri 7 Oct 2026. Each needs a detail-page fetch to confirm IDs, scope, deliverables, dates and contacts before it can be recorded as a tender.
Detail/deliverables extraction: not possible for any opportunity this run because no notice or tender document could be opened.

Discovered sources this run could not be fetch-verified (URL resolution, feed/API presence, and current-opportunity confirmation all pending) due to the egress block; each is noted accordingly and should be re-checked once egress is restored.

Proxy status checked (curl $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status): enabled=true, selective=false, bundleCoversEveryHost=true, no external tender domains permitted - consistent with an allowlist that admits only infrastructure hosts (Anthropic API, package registries). This is an environment/configuration issue, not a transient network error, and has now persisted for six days.
recommended_seed_additions: Airservices Australia - Information for suppliers (https://www.airservicesaustralia.com/about-us/information-for-suppliers/) - Commonwealth GBE (air navigation / aviation rescue and fire fighting); procurement via SAP Ariba Network with ATMs advertised on AusTender. Sibling to AMSA already tracked; aviation-safety GBE coverage was absent.

Pilbara Ports Authority - Tender and business opportunities (https://www.pilbaraports.com.au/business-and-trade/tender-and-business-opportunities) - WA port GBE (world's largest bulk-export ports); advertises public tenders via Tenders WA. Complements Mid West Ports / Southern Ports / Fremantle Ports already tracked.

Flinders Ports - Procurement / supplier information (https://www.flindersports.com.au/) - SA private port operator running seven SA ports; procurement/tender entry point to confirm once egress is restored. SA port coverage was absent from the known set.

Australian Defence Industry Portal (AusDIP) via BenchOn (https://www.benchon.com/ausdip/) - no-cost defence industry matching portal carrying EOI-to-RFP opportunities from defence primes (the same BenchOn platform Hanwha Defence Australia already uses). Useful as a single discovery surface for defence-prime subcontract packages.

Moonee Valley City Council (VIC) - Tenders (https://www.mvcc.vic.gov.au/) - metropolitan Melbourne local-government buyer; VIC council coverage in the known set skews regional. Confirm the live tenders URL and platform (VendorPanel vs council e-tendering) once egress is restored.

ENVIRONMENT FIX (highest priority): the daily routine cannot fulfil its core mission while the egress proxy blocks all external hosts (now six days). Allowlist the Tier 1 government tender domains (tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au/buyingfor.vic.gov.au, qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au/supply.qld.gov.au, tenders.wa.gov.au, tenders.sa.gov.au, tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, tenders.act.gov.au), plus vendorpanel.com.au, portal.tenderlink.com and service.ariba.com, so WebFetch can open and verify notices.
